notes: ErrorPrompt-only instant disconnect detection: telemetry v2.2 triggers solely when CoreGui.RobloxPromptGui.promptOverlay.ErrorPrompt is effectively visible. Detection no longer depends on Leave/Reconnect labels, localization, button count, title or error text. ChildAdded + Visible-change hooks provide instant detection with polling fallback; text/error code are diagnostics only. Watchdog consumes the durable event mailbox and immediately rejoins after the client exits.
